source.title: Why Vitest
source.description: Rationale for a Vite-native runner: shares `vite.config.js` and plugins with your app, Jest-compatible API for drop-in migration, parallel workers, watch-by-default.

source.title: Getting Started
source.description: Install Vitest and run a first test: Vite/Node version requirements, `.test.`/`.spec.` file naming, `bun run test` vs `bun test`, plus example projects per framework.

source.title: Configuring Vitest
source.description: Choosing `vitest.config` versus `vite.config`, the `test` property, extending defaults with `configDefaults` or `mergeConfig`, and skipping dependency install prompts.

source.title: Features
source.description: High-level capability tour; notably why only `VITE_` env vars load, `.concurrent` tests needing local `expect`, and handling unhandled errors.

source.title: Writing Tests
source.description: Test basics: `describe` grouping, default test file patterns, TypeScript without type-checking, `.only`/`.skip`/`.todo`, `test.for` parameterized cases versus `test.each`, and `globals: true` setup.

source.title: Using Matchers
source.description: Choosing between `toBe`, `toEqual` and `toStrictEqual`, float rounding with `toBeCloseTo`, partial object matching, asymmetric matchers, why `toThrow` needs a wrapper function, and `expect.soft`.

source.title: Testing Asynchronous Code
source.description: Await promises or use `.resolves`/`.rejects`, wrap callbacks, guard skipped assertions with `expect.assertions`, raise the 5s timeout, and fix unhandled rejection failures.

source.title: Setup and Teardown
source.description: Beginner intro to `beforeEach`/`afterAll` hooks, `describe` scoping and nested execution order, `onTestFinished` cleanup, `test.extend` fixtures, and `setupFiles`.

source.title: Mock Functions
source.description: Beginner intro to `vi.fn`, `vi.spyOn` and `vi.mock`: stubbing return values, asserting calls, `mockClear` vs `mockReset` vs `mockRestore`, and why `.mock.calls` sees mutated arguments.

source.title: Snapshot Testing
source.description: Beginner intro to `toMatchSnapshot`, inline and file snapshots, updating with `vitest -u`, ignoring timestamps/IDs via property matchers, and snapshotting thrown errors.

source.title: Testing in Practice
source.description: Deciding what to test, when to mock versus use real dependencies, edge cases, reproducing bugs with failing tests, and organizing test files with `describe`.

source.title: Debugging Failing Tests
source.description: Beginner walkthrough of reading failure diffs and isolating a test, then fixing tests that pass alone but fail in the suite, missing `await`, leaked mocks and "document is not defined".

source.title: Writing Tests with AI
source.description: Prompting AI agents for good tests and reviewing their output: Jest APIs like `jest.fn()` slipping in, over-mocking, leaked mocks, weak assertions, and watch mode hanging agents (use `vitest run`).

source.title: Why Browser Mode
source.description: Real browser versus jsdom or happy-dom simulation and its false results; drawbacks: slower startup and no replacement for end-to-end runners.

source.title: Browser Mode {#browser-mode}
source.description: Set up and run tests in a real browser: `vitest init browser`, choosing a provider, `browser.instances`, headless, framework render packages, and why `vi.spyOn` on module exports and `alert` fail.

source.title: Configuring Playwright
source.description: Set up `@vitest/browser-playwright` and pass `launchOptions`, `contextOptions`, `actionTimeout` or `persistentContext`; connect to a remote or Docker Playwright server via `wsEndpoint`.

source.title: Configuring Preview
source.description: Set up the `@vitest/browser-preview` provider in your default browser, and its limits: no headless mode, duplicate browser instances, CDP, or real `userEvent` integration.

source.title: Multiple Setups
source.description: Run tests across chromium, firefox and webkit with `browser.instances`, vary `setupFiles` or `provide` per instance, and filter by `--project` name.

source.title: Component Testing
source.description: Patterns for testing UI components in Browser Mode: mocking children and APIs with MSW, forms, error boundaries, accessibility, debugging failing selectors, using Testing Library via `page.elementLocator()`, and migrating from Jest.

source.title: Visual Regression Testing
source.description: Screenshot testing with `toMatchScreenshot`: creating and updating references, reading diffs, thresholds and custom comparators, fixing flaky font or size mismatches, and consistent references via CI, Azure or Chromatic.

source.title: Trace View 5.0.0
source.description: Replay browser test steps as DOM snapshots in Vitest UI or the HTML report for CI failures; add `page.mark()` entries, inspect retries, and fix missing images, canvas or fonts.

source.title: Playwright Traces
source.description: Enable the `trace` option to record trace files on failure or retry, set `tracesDir`, add `page.mark()` timeline markers, and open them with `npx playwright show-trace`.

source.title: ARIA Snapshots 4.1.4 {#aria-snapshots}
source.description: Assert accessibility trees with `toMatchAriaSnapshot()`: the YAML-like format, regex patterns surviving `--update`, doubled backslash escaping, and `/children` partial or exact matching.

source.title: Test Context
source.description: Built-in context (`expect`, `skip`, `signal`, `bench`) and custom fixtures via `test.extend`: `onCleanup` teardown, worker/file scopes, `test.override`, and fixture-aware `test.beforeAll`.

source.title: Test Run Lifecycle
source.description: Execution order of `globalSetup`, setup files, workers and hooks (incl. nested `aroundEach`/`beforeEach`), which run in main process vs worker, and watch-mode reruns.

source.title: Snapshot
source.description: Inline and `toMatchFileSnapshot` snapshots, updating with `-u`, why CI fails on obsolete snapshots, custom serializers, matchers and domain adapters, and Jest output differences.

source.title: Test Tags 4.1.0 {#test-tags}
source.description: Label tests to share `timeout`/`retry` options and run subsets with `--tags-filter` expressions; covers `@module-tag`, priority conflicts, `strictTags` errors and `TestRunner.matchesTags`.

source.title: Test Annotations
source.description: Attach messages and file attachments to tests with `annotate`, and why annotations only appear on failure in the default reporter versus `verbose`, `junit`, `github-actions` and `tap`.

source.title: Extending Matchers
source.description: Write custom matchers with `expect.extend`, type them via the `Matchers` interface, handle async matchers, and use `this` helpers like `isNot`, `equals` and `utils`.

source.title: Testing Types
source.description: Write `*.test-d.ts` type tests with `expectTypeOf` or `assertType`, enable `--typecheck`, decode cryptic mismatch errors, and catch false-passing `@ts-expect-error` typos.

source.title: Benchmarking
source.description: Write `bench` fixture benchmarks, run via `vitest bench`, compare with `bench.compare()`, assert `toBeFasterThan`, store baselines, and avoid misleading results.

source.title: In-Source Testing
source.description: Write tests inside source files via `import.meta.vitest` and `includeSource` to reach private state; strip them from production builds with `define` (Vite, Rollup, webpack) and add `vitest/importMeta` types.

source.title: Command Line Interface
source.description: Large reference to search: `run`, `related`, `list` and `doctor` (finds a faster pool) commands, `file:line` filtering, shell completions, every flag, `--shard`.

source.title: Test Filtering
source.description: Run one file, test name (`-t`), line number or tag; `.only`, `.skip`, `.todo`, why `.only` fails CI, and why filtered runs stay slow.

source.title: Test Projects
source.description: Run monorepo or multi-config setups (formerly `workspace`) in one process: glob patterns, inline configs, `extends` inheritance, unsupported project options, `--project` filtering, nested projects and `DEBUG=vitest:projects`.

source.title: Test Environment
source.description: Choosing `node`, `jsdom`, `happy-dom` or `edge-runtime`, per-file `@vitest-environment` comments, fixing `unknown extension .css` errors, and writing custom environments.

source.title: Reporters
source.description: Choose and combine output formats without losing defaults (`configDefaults.reporters`), set `outputFile`, customise JUnit names, GitHub Actions job summaries, merge sharded `blob` reports, debug hanging processes.

source.title: Vitest UI
source.description: Run `--ui` live or a static `html` reporter for CI and `singleFile` sharing; module graph shows slow imports and transformed code.

source.title: IDE Integrations
source.description: Links to the official VS Code extension, built-in JetBrains support (WebStorm, IntelliJ, PhpStorm), and the paid Wallaby.js run-as-you-type plugin.

source.title: Coverage
source.description: Choosing `v8` vs `istanbul`, why untested files are missing from the report (`coverage.include`), `-- @preserve` ignore comments that survive esbuild, and custom reporters/providers.

source.title: Database Transaction per Test
source.description: Roll back each test's DB writes via `aroundEach` and a file-scoped `db` fixture; share one connection per worker with `isolate: false`.

source.title: Cancellable Test Resources
source.description: Stop hung tests on `timeout`, `--bail` or Ctrl+C by passing the test context `signal` to `fetch`, child processes, timers and polling helpers.

source.title: Waiting for Async Conditions
source.description: Choose between `expect.poll`, `vi.waitFor` and `vi.waitUntil` to replace flaky `setTimeout` sleeps: retry semantics, `timeout`/`interval` defaults, fake timers.

source.title: Type Narrowing in Tests
source.description: Replace `as` casts and `!` with `expect.assert` on possibly-undefined values; why `toBeTruthy`/`toBeDefined` don't narrow types, plus `typeof`/`instanceof` narrowing.

source.title: Custom Assertion Helpers
source.description: Make failures in reusable helpers that call `expect` point at the test's call site, not the helper's internals, using `vi.defineHelper`.

source.title: Watching Non-Imported Files
source.description: Why watch mode misses edits to templates, fixtures or files read via `fs`; map them to tests with `watchTriggerPatterns` instead of `forceRerunTriggers`.

source.title: Domain Locators
source.description: Add custom browser locator methods with `locators.extend` when `getByRole` can't express a query: Playwright selector strings, chained/filtered locators, interaction helpers, and `LocatorSelectors` type augmentation.

source.title: Schema-Driven Assertions
source.description: Reuse Zod, Valibot or ArkType schemas in tests via `expect.schemaMatching`, e.g. checking mock call arguments or generated UUIDs and timestamps.

source.title: Auto-Cleanup with `using`
source.description: Auto-restore `vi.spyOn`, `vi.fn` and `vi.doMock` at block exit without `afterEach`, mock for part of a test only, TypeScript/Node version requirements, and the `onTestFinished` fallback.

source.title: Conditional Mocking with `vi.when`
source.description: Return different values per argument with `calledWith` and `thenResolve`/`thenThrowOnce`, including action and matcher ordering, `onUnmatched`, and `toHaveBeenExhausted`.

source.title: Per-File Isolation Settings
source.description: Speed up unit tests with `isolate: false` via `projects` while keeping integration tests isolated; which files are unsafe to deisolate and checking with `--shuffle`.

source.title: Comparisons with Other Test Runners
source.description: Whether to choose Vitest over Jest, Mocha or uvu, and how it pairs with Playwright, Cypress or WebdriverIO for E2E and real-browser tests.
